products.descriptionEs: Incluye zanahorias y aderezo de queso azul o ranch. Un sabor por orden. Sabores: suave, picante, Killer, miel picante, BBQ Jack Daniels, ajo y parmesano, sazón cajún seca, teriyaki, chile dulce, mostaza con miel.
products.descriptionEn: Comes with carrots and blue cheese or ranch. One flavor per order. Flavors: Mild, Hot, Killer, Honey-Hot, Jack Daniels BBQ, Garlic Parmesan, Cajun Dry Rub, Teriyaki, Sweet Chili, Honey Mustard.

products.descriptionEn: 3 pork spring rolls, 2 fried mozzarella, 1 philly egg roll & fries. Comes with marinara, teriyaki & garlic aioli.

products.descriptionEn: 4 Homemade mozzarella breaded in panko, fried and served with marinara

products.descriptionEn: Hand rolled spring rolls with pork, carrot, green onion. Served with teriyaki or sweet chili.

products.descriptionEs: Quesadillas hechas a mano en tortilla de harina rellenas de queso cheddar jack, cebolla, pimientos, salsa/crema agria (pollo), alioli/queso fundido (Philly steak).
products.descriptionEn: Hand rolled Quesadillas on a flour tortilla filled with cheddar jack cheese, onions peppers, salsa/sour cream (chicken), aioli/queso (Philly steak).

products.descriptionEs: Rollitos primavera hechos a mano con dip búfalo. Servidos con ranch o queso azul.
products.descriptionEn: Hand rolled spring rolls with buffalo dip. Served with ranch or blue cheese.

products.nameEs: Rollitos de Philly steak con queso
products.descriptionEs: Rollitos hechos a mano rellenos de Philly steak, queso y pimientos. Cubiertos con cebolla morada encurtida. Servidos con alioli de ajo, chipotle o queso fundido, a elegir.
products.descriptionEn: Hand rolled eggrolls stuffed with philly steak, cheese & peppers. Topped with pickled red onion. Served with choice of garlic aioli, chipotle & queso.

products.descriptionEs: Hamburguesa de res Black Angus de 7 oz con lechuga, tomate y queso americano, cheddar o pepper jack a elegir. Incluye papas fritas cortadas a mano.
products.descriptionEn: 7oz black angus beef burger topped with lettuce, tomato and choice of American, Cheddar or Pepper-jack cheese. Comes with hand cut fries.

products.descriptionEs: Dos carnes smash cubiertas con queso americano, lechuga, tomate, tocino y la salsa secreta de Bleachers. Incluye papas fritas cortadas a mano.
products.descriptionEn: Two smash patties topped with American cheese, lettuce, tomato, bacon & Bleachers secret sauce. Comes with hand cut fries.

products.descriptionEs: Cubierta con queso cheddar, tocino, cebolla frita crujiente y salsa BBQ JD. Incluye papas fritas cortadas a mano.
products.descriptionEn: Topped with cheddar cheese, bacon, frizzled onions & JD BBQ sauce. Comes with hand cut fries.

products.descriptionEs: Hamburguesa cubierta con tocino ahumado con madera de manzano y queso azul. Incluye papas fritas cortadas a mano.
products.descriptionEn: Burger topped with Applewood bacon & bleu cheese. Comes with hand cut fries.

products.descriptionEs: Pollo ennegrecido, tomate, lechuga, jalapeños, tocino, queso pepper jack y mayonesa de chipotle en wrap.
products.descriptionEn: Blackened chicken, tomato, lettuce, jalapenos, bacon, pepper-jack cheese & chipotle mayo in a wrap.

products.descriptionEs: Pollo a la parrilla, lechuga, queso parmesano y aderezo César.
